1.d4 f5 2.g3 g6 3.Bg2.strategy: Finishes the fianchetto at once. The bishop covers the king and bears on the long diagonal and on e4, the square the f5 pawn weakened, and White keeps the knights flexible.

1.d4 f5 2.g3 g6 3.Bg2 Bg7.strategy: Answers White's fianchetto with one of its own: the bishop presses on the long diagonal against d4 and prepares castling. The g8 knight stays flexible, and Black has not yet decided on a pawn structure.
